svg.title: M129 — Bit-position periodic table / CFSG labels / enhanced thematic plate
svg.desc: Organize bit indices into a table with powers of two, symbolic families and heuristic scores. Such a table can be an interface for diagnostics. Original finding: Supplied transcript uses simulated random biases and organizational labels; no local validated cryptanalytic result was established.
